label: PF Backlog 580
title: language_rule_review <item>: read the item's APPROXIMATE planned_change so Gate 1 gives the Go/Python size verdict without --plan (decide at Gate 1, avoid rework)
body: At Gate 1 the worker knows (approximately) how big the planned change is. The take-up language review should answer Go-vs-Python for BOTH the file KIND (shipped/tooling/new) and the planned SIZE (a large edit to shipped Python is new logic -> Go), from the item alone. Enhancement: read an optional item.planned_change = {path: {added, removed, new_defs, new_branches}} (an estimate is fine) and feed the SAME edit-growth policy. The ENFORCING language_rule_check still uses the real git diff.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend the existing take-up/context-review language gate (core/context_review or core/iteration_planner edit-growth policy) to read optional item.planned_change (per-path added/removed/new_defs/new_branches, approximate OK) from /api/v1/backlog/items/{item_id} and apply the SAME edit-growth thresholds so Gate 1 returns a combined Go/Python verdict for file kind + planned size. Reuse code_quality_gate thresholds from config/ci-cd-gates.json; no new component.

duplication_findings: No existing item exposes planned_change consumption; BI-PF-0339 (ENG-0 architecture descriptor) is upstream producer, not duplicate

analysis.rationale: Small extension of an existing gate with reused thresholds; makes Gate 1 verdict deterministic in one pass and avoids rework. Optional field keeps it backward compatible.
